{{Top|canon=Generis Station}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
'''Generis orbital base''' was a base for the leadership of the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]]. It was located in a long abandoned [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Generis system/Legends|Generis system]]. Here, the leadership signed the [[Treaty of Generis]] with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], bringing the ARG into the wider [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
